name: PRD Penrith - Buyer Enquiry Assistant v2 (copy, INACTIVE)

nodes.name: Fetch Recent Listings
nodes.notes: Listings modified in the last 120 days, roughly 10 pages. Fetched inline every run because n8n static data does not survive concurrent executions - the cache and the main flow were overwriting each other.

nodes.name: Poll Vault for New Enquiries
nodes.notes: Every 10 minutes. Volume is roughly 3 enquiries a week, so a tighter poll just burns API calls against the 10,000/day limit.

nodes.name: Fetch New Vault Enquiries
nodes.notes: CONFIRMED endpoint. 30-minute window with the idempotency guard behind it, so a late-running execution cannot drop an enquiry.

nodes.name: Idempotency Guard
nodes.notes: Static data only persists on production executions. Manual test runs will re-process the same enquiries each time - that is expected.

nodes.name: Safe to Proceed?
nodes.notes: Fail-safe. Nothing reaches the assistant until this passes.

nodes.name: Fetch Property
nodes.notes: If this 404s, the next node detects it and the assistant is told it has no property facts. It will then ask which property rather than inventing anything.

nodes.name: Build Property Fact Sheet
nodes.notes: The model only ever sees these named fields, never the raw Vault record.

parameters.jsCode:
// One row per conversation turn, for the dashboard and for conversation memory.
const d = $json;

const lastAssistant = [...(d.conversationHistory || [])]
  .reverse().find(m => m.role === 'assistant');

return {
  json: {
    timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
    localTime: d.localTime ?? '',
    conversationId: d.conversationId ?? '',
    enquiryId: d.enquiryId ?? '',
    buyer: d.contactName ?? '',
    phone: d.contactPhone ?? '',
    email: d.contactEmail ?? '',
    property: d.propertyAddress ?? '',
    hadPropertyRecord: d.knowledgeBase?.hasProperty ?? false,
    source: d.source ?? '',
    channel: d.channel ?? '',
    agent: d.agentName ?? '',
    afterHours: d.afterHours ?? '',
    turn: d.turns ?? 1,
    buyerMessage: d.message ?? '',
    assistantReply: d.reply ?? (lastAssistant?.content ?? ''),
    temperature: d.temperature ?? 'New',
    buyerType: d.buyerType ?? '',
    financeStatus: d.financeStatus ?? '',
    needsToSellFirst: d.needsToSellFirst === true ? 'Yes' : (d.needsToSellFirst === false ? 'No' : ''),
    timeframe: d.timeframe ?? '',
    inspection: d.inspectionInterest ?? '',
    wantsContract: d.wantsContract ?? false,
    consent: d.consentGranted
      ? `Yes - ${d.consentChannel}`
      : (d.consentDeclined ? 'Declined' : 'Not yet asked'),
    readyForAgent: d.readyForAgent ?? false,
    whyReady: d.whyReady ?? '',
    contactId: d.contactId ?? '',
    blocked: Array.isArray(d.blockReasons) && d.blockReasons.length ? d.blockReasons.join('; ') : '',
    // Carried so a later reply can find the same property without re-resolving it.
    propertyVaultId: d.propertyVaultId ?? '',
    saleLifeId: d.saleLifeId ?? '',
    agentUserId: d.agentUserId ?? '',
    agentEmail: d.agentEmail ?? '',
    handoffStatus: d.handoffStatus ?? 'none',
    slaDueAt: d.slaDueAtIso ?? null,
    buyerAt: d.receivedAt ?? new Date().toISOString(),
    replyAt: new Date().toISOString()
  }
};

parameters.jsCode:
// Maps the Activity Log row to the dashboard ingest schema (src/lib/data/ingest.ts).
const j = $json;
const iso = (v) => { const t = new Date(v); return isNaN(t) ? null : t.toISOString(); };
const nowIso = new Date().toISOString();
return {
  json: {
    conversationId: String(j.conversationId || ''),
    enquiryId: String(j.enquiryId || ''),
    buyer: String(j.buyer || ''),
    phone: String(j.phone || ''),
    email: String(j.email || ''),
    property: String(j.property || ''),
    source: String(j.source || ''),
    agent: String(j.agent || ''),
    temperature: ['Hot', 'Warm', 'New'].includes(j.temperature) ? j.temperature : 'New',
    buyerType: String(j.buyerType || ''),
    financeStatus: String(j.financeStatus || ''),
    needsToSellFirst: String(j.needsToSellFirst || ''),
    timeframe: String(j.timeframe || ''),
    inspection: String(j.inspection || 'not_discussed'),
    wantsContract: Boolean(j.wantsContract),
    consent: String(j.consent || ''),
    readyForAgent: Boolean(j.readyForAgent),
    whyReady: String(j.whyReady || ''),
    handoffStatus: ['none', 'pending', 'done'].includes(j.handoffStatus) ? j.handoffStatus : 'none',
    slaDueAt: iso(j.slaDueAt),
    afterHours: j.afterHours === true,
    blocked: String(j.blocked || ''),
    turn: Number(j.turn) || 1,
    buyerMessage: String(j.buyerMessage || ''),
    assistantReply: String(j.assistantReply || ''),
    buyerAt: iso(j.buyerAt) || nowIso,
    replyAt: iso(j.replyAt) || nowIso
  }
};
